name: Raptor Grounds
summary: In the southern Barrens, Sunscale raptors claim a secluded valley in the rocky hills west of Northwatch Hold. Their eerie, tool-using cunning and obsessive theft of bright trinkets set them apart from ordinary beasts.

sections.title: Uncanny Beasts of the Southern Wastes
sections.body: West of Northwatch Hold, Sunscale raptors make their home in the Raptor Grounds. Eerie and far from ordinary beasts, they fashion crude shelters, make primitive tools, and coordinate their hunts. Their obsessive fascination with shiny or unusual things drives them to raid passing caravans and Horde encampments. Coins, trinkets, and supplies disappear into their canyon dens.

faq.answer: The Raptor Grounds is a small, sunken valley in the southern Barrens, in the rocky hills west of Northwatch Hold.

faq.q: Why are the raptors here different from normal beasts?
faq.answer: Sunscale raptors show an unnatural degree of intelligence. They assemble primitive tools and build crude huts to shelter their pack and hide stolen goods.

faq.q: Why do the raptors attack caravans and steal items?
faq.answer: The pack has an obsessive attraction to shiny, glittering, or unusual objects. That fascination drives the raptors to ambush travelers and raid Horde settlements, hoarding stolen coin and metal deep in their valley.
Neither faction holds the valley. It remains the untamed hunting and nesting ground of the wild Sunscale raptors, who fiercely defend it against intruders.

angles.text: Sunscale raptors threaten Horde caravans and outposts across the southern Barrens, prompting bounties and expeditions to recover stolen wealth.
As a Hunter, you may find the Sunscale pack’s unusual cunning, coordinated hunts, and rudimentary shelters fascinating to study as a tracker.
